person_facts.yes: I have a long-term physical or mental health condition or illness.
person_facts.no: I don't have any long-term health condition.
person_facts.measure: Has a physical or mental health condition or illness lasting or expected to last 12 months or more (disabled limited a lot + limited a little + non-disabled with non-limiting condition). Census question: 'Do you have any physical or mental health conditions or illnesses lasting or expected to last 12 months or more?'
person_facts.source: ONS, Disability by age, sex and deprivation, England and Wales: Census 2021 (released 8 February 2023) (2021 (Census Day 21 March 2021))
person_facts.table: Figure 1 data download (https://www.ons.gov.uk/visualisations/dvc2232/fig1/datadownload.xlsx): Age-specific percentages of disability by age group and sex, England 2021

person_facts.no: I'm not on any regular prescribed medicine.
person_facts.measure: Took at least one prescribed medicine in the last week (excluding contraceptives and smoking-cessation products / nicotine replacement), recorded at the HSE nurse visit
person_facts.source: NHS Digital, Health Survey for England 2016: Prescribed medicines (Excel tables) (2015/16 (pooled HSE 2015 and 2016; published 13 December 2017))
person_facts.table: Table 1: Number of prescribed medicines taken in the last week, by age and sex

person_facts.yes: I provide unpaid care for a family member, friend or neighbour.
person_facts.measure: Provides unpaid care. Census question: 'Do you look after, or give any help or support to, anyone because they have long-term physical or mental health conditions or illnesses, or problems related to old age?' (excluding anything done as part of paid employment)
person_facts.source: ONS, Unpaid care by age, sex and deprivation, England and Wales: Census 2021 (released 13 February 2023) (2021)
person_facts.table: Figure 1 data download (https://www.ons.gov.uk/visualisations/dvc2234/fig1/datadownload.xlsx): Age-specific percentages of unpaid carers by age group, sex and number of unpaid care hours provided per week, England, 2021

person_facts.yes: I often find written health information — leaflets, letters, dosage instructions — hard to make sense of.
person_facts.measure: Below the competency threshold needed to understand and use commonly used English health information materials: (a) text (literacy) only; (b) text + numeracy
person_facts.source: Rowlands G, Protheroe J, Winkley J, Richardson M, Seed PT, Rudd R. A mismatch between population health literacy and the complexity of health information: an observational study. British Journal of General Practice 2015;65(635):e379-e386. doi:10.3399/bjgp15X685285 (Skills data: 2011 Skills for Life Survey (fieldwork May 2010 - Feb 2011); paper published 2015)
person_facts.table: Results / Abstract; Table 2 'Literacy competency descriptive analyses'

person_facts.yes: I've been living with symptoms of anxiety or depression lately.
person_facts.measure: CIS-R score of 12 or more (CMHC symptoms 'of a level likely to benefit from acknowledgement and possible intervention'); 18+ = severe symptoms
person_facts.source: NHS England, APMS 2023/4, Chapter 1: Common mental health conditions (2023/4)
person_facts.table: Chart data 'CIS-R score of 12-17 and 18 or more, by age (Base: All adults)'

person_facts.measure: Current cigarette smoker: 'Have you ever smoked cigarettes regularly?' -> 'Do you smoke cigarettes at all nowadays?' = yes (Annual Population Survey)
person_facts.source: ONS, Adult smoking habits in the UK: 2025 (2025 (released 6 October 2026))
person_facts.table: Figure 3 data download (https://www.ons.gov.uk/visualisations/dvc3642/fig03/datadownload.xlsx): Percentage who were current smokers, all persons by age group, UK, 2011 to 2025

person_facts.yes: I'm living with obesity (BMI 30 or more).
person_facts.measure: Obese: measured BMI of 30 kg/m2 or more (includes morbidly obese, BMI 40+)
person_facts.source: NHS England, Health Survey for England 2022 Part 2: Overweight and obesity (Excel tables) (2022)
person_facts.table: Table 4: Adults' body mass index (BMI), overweight and obesity prevalence, by age and sex (row '% Obese')
